providers.name: berkshire-hathaway-travel-protection
providers.title: Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection
providers.summary: Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection (BHTP) is committed to providing travelers with trip protection that is simpler and smarter than ever before. BHTP has an innovative claim platform that lets travelers initiate a claim with a simple picture from their mobile device. And, if that claim is brought to fulfillment, Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection works to get a traveler reimbursed faster.
providers.summaryListing: With faster claims than ever, Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection provides travelers with comprehensive travel insurance that fits their ever moving lifestyle.
providers.content:
When you purchase a plan from Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection (BHTP), you are protecting your trip with a comprehensive travel insurance plan you can depend on.

It’s hard to ignore BHTP’s commitments to the travelers who purchase their plans. BHTP communicates the way you communicate; whether that’s through social media, online chat, email, text or a phone call. BHTP is there for you, no matter the reason, in a way that best fits your busy life.

Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection works hard to streamline the claims process to reimburse their travelers faster than ever. With the snap of a photo, your claim (such as a claim for a lost or stolen bag) can be launched through your mobile device.

If that claim, or any other, is approved, you’ll be waiting less time for that reimbursement – getting that money directly deposited into the account of your choice. Gone are the days of having to wait for a paper check that needs to be endorsed and deposited into your account. With Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection’s electronic payments, you can receive your money faster so you can get back to your trip.

The comprehensive benefits that are included, as well as optional coverages and upgrades available to most travelers, make the Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection plans an excellent choice for travelers. For instance, if you purchase the plan within 15 days of your initial trip payment, you’ll most likely be eligible to include:

  • pre-existing condition waiver
  • trip cancellation and interruption due to financial default

Still unsure? Every BHTP plan includes a 15-Day Free Look, meaning, you have 15 days to decide if the plan is the right plan for you and your trip.

Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection (BHTP) is a registered trademark and a subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway Specialty Insurance Company (BHSI), a leader in specialized casualty and liability insurance.

highlights.content: Fast mobile claims process, reimbursing approved claims faster than ever

providers.summary: With over 20 years of experience, Medjet brings a unique service to the travel industry. They offer memberships that provide domestic and international air-medical transport, travel security and crisis response services. If a Medjet member should become hospitalized more than 150 miles from home, the member can be transported to their home hospital of choice for continued treatment and recovery. If they feel their safety is being threatened while traveling, MedjetHorizon members also have access to a 24/7 crisis response line.
providers.summaryListing: Medjet offers memberships of different lengths that cover air medical transport services if you are hospitalized more than 150 miles from your home.
providers.content:
Purchasing a Medjet membership is not like purchasing a traditional travel policy. It does not cover trip interruption or hospital bills. These memberships are designed to give travelers peace of mind ~ and more control over their safety and medical care.

A MEDJETASSIST membership provides and pays for hospital-to-hospital air-medical transfer if an injury or illness and hospitalization occur more than 150 miles from home (domestic plus international coverage). Unlike health or travel insurance, which typically transports only to the “nearest acceptable facility,” a Medjet Member can be transferred to their home hospital of choice, regardless of medical necessity, for the cost of the membership and nothing more. With medical transport costs ranging from $30,000 to over $180,000, why risk it?

MEDJETHORIZON membership includes all the air-medical transport benefits of MedjetAssist, plus worldwide travel security, crisis response and evacuation services. Members have access to a 24/7 travel security network, powered by global corporate security providers FocusPoint International, for an in-country response to a wide range of safety concerns and threats while traveling including violent crime, terrorism, natural disaster, kidnapping for ransom, political threat, wrongful detention and more. These safety concerns are sadly a growing reality for today’s travelers, even in places once considered “safe.” MedjetHorizon can respond as soon as a member feels uneasy; there is no need to wait for government-issued hard triggers or evacuation orders.

Medjet memberships are available with no preexisting condition questions or exclusions for travelers under age 75. For travelers age 75-84, please call us at 1-800-487-4722 for the Medjet Diamond Membership.

This plan also includes emergency medical reimbursement and emergency medical evacuation if deemed necessary by the attending doctor. The Assistance Services also include Medical Repatriation, Urgent Message Relay, Legal Referrals, Lost Document Assistance, and so on. The full list of services can be found in the plan details.

This plan also includes a 24-hour travel assistance service available to assist you with anything from medical referrals while on your trip, to coordinating a medical evacuation, to concierge services. Whether it is a serious medical emergency during your trip, or if you need help finding a certain restaurant at your destination, the coverage and services offered with this plan can help in many ways.

plans.name: preferred
plans.title: Preferred
plans.content:
If you are looking for a travel insurance plan that offers more coverage and higher benefit limits—particularly in terms of medical benefits—than a basic plan, but at a lower price point than a high-end program, the Preferred plan from Generali Global Assistance could be your best bet.

This popular plan includes all of the same coverages as the Standard plan, plus specific coverages for sporting equipment and sporting equipment delay—ideal for skiers, golfers, snorkelers and more, as well as Accidental Death & Dismemberment – Travel Accident if you are injured in an accident while on your trip. The plan also boasts higher benefit limits on coverages compared to what is available with the Standard plan, such as trip interruption up to 150% of the total trip cost insured; $1500 of Baggage protection per plan holder; and $150,000 of medical and dental per plan holder.

In addition, if you purchase the Preferred plan prior to or within 24 hours of your final trip payment, you can get coverage for financial insolvency, meaning the plan can reimburse you in case you are forced to cancel or interrupt your trip if one of your travel suppliers (airline, cruise line or tour operator) discontinues operations due to insolvency, with or without filing bankruptcy.

Last, but not least, this plan comes with a variety of services designed to help you get the most from your vacation and give you a little extra peace of mind. For example, On Demand Medical Care can instantly connect you with a network of physicians for information, advice, and treatment through a service called Teladoc. And with No Out-of-Pocket Medical, you can receive payment reimbursement up to $1,000 for acute treatments from a trusted provider if you get sick or injured while traveling. Please note that Teladoc services may not be available in all states and international services may be limited.

Travel insurance coverages are underwritten by: Generali U.S. Branch, New York, NY; NAIC # 11231, for the operating name used in certain states, please see Important Disclosures.

plans.name: trekker-choice
plans.title: Trekker Choice
plans.content:
The GeoBlue Trekker Choice is a multi-trip travel medical plan for travelers looking for emergency medical coverage while traveling abroad. The plan covers trips no longer than 70 days in length per trip that you will be taking outside the United States during a period of one year. The plan does require you to have primary health insurance in place, but there is no exclusion for pre-existing conditions.

With the Trekker Choice plan, the medical limit is $1,000,000 and there is a $100 deductible. For travelers over age 69, the maximum medical limit is $100,000. This plan also includes $25,000 benefit for claims resulting from a listed hazardous activity such as, downhill skiing and scuba diving (certification by the Professional Association of Diving Instructors (PADI) or the National Association of Underwater Instructors (NAUI) required or diving under the supervision of a certified instructor).

You are provided with an emergency assistance number to call 24/7 in the event you need medical assistance or an emergency evacuation during your trip. This plan also features the Direct Pay program, which will pay medical bills upfront if the appointment was made with a medical provider in the GeoBlue network and GeoBlue is aware of the appointment 24-hours in advance.

The Trekker Choice plan offers 24/7 telemedicine visits at no extra cost to members. Through Global TeleMD, members are able to secure a same day virtual visit with GeoBlue’s global network of doctors. The program offers multiple language options and consultation notes are sent directly to your phone. Additionally, Trekker Choice members have access to GeoBlue’s award-winning app providing medical term and phrase translations, a medicine equivalent tool, and news and safety information based on your location, and more.

The GeoBlue travel medical plans are available for purchase only before your departure date. If you have already departed on your trip, do not purchase this plan because you will not have any coverage.

note54da41cb3eb01.content:
Will GeoBlue provide coverage and waive cost-sharing for the COVID-19 test?
The claim will be covered in any of the following circumstances:

 - Prescribed testing from a doctor
 - Contact testing
 - Medical facility admission testing
If there is no indication of the above and the claim is related to non-diagnostic testing as a prerequisite for work, school or entry into country, the claim will not be covered.

Cost-sharing:
Coverage is available with no cost-share for diagnostic testing for COVID-19, consistent with U.S. Centers for Disease Control (CDC) guidelines. Starting January 1, 2021, existing plan rules apply where there may be cost sharing for a COVID-19 test. Please consult your Certificate of Coverage for more information on coverage and benefits.

Are there any restrictions for purchasing plans to travel to a high-risk country?
GeoBlue plans are available for purchase, however we do encourage travelers to review and consider all travel plans according to travel restrictions country-by-country. Treatment for COVID-19 is covered as an Illness under GeoBlue Voyager plans, and we are waiving copay and other member contribution for covered treatment of COVID-19 cases diagnosed. Starting January 1, 2021, existing plan rules apply where there may be cost sharing.

I have a Voyager/Trekker travel plan. Am I covered for medical evacuations related to COVID-19?
Medical evacuations due to COVID-19 are currently not covered under Voyager and Trekker plans.

For all CDC references, please visit: https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices

Who is eligible for coverage?

Covered Persons are the only people qualified to be covered by this Certificate. The following section describes who qualifies as an Eligible Participant or Eligible Dependent, as well as information on when and who to enroll and when coverage begins and ends.

Who is Eligible to Enroll Under This Certificate?

Eligible Participant
An Eligible Participant means:
1. A member of the Global Citizens Association (GCA) covered under this Certificate;
2. Has submitted an enrollment form, if applicable, and the premium to the Insurer;
3. Meets the eligibility requirements as stated in this Certificate of Coverage;

Eligible Dependents
An Eligible Dependent means a person who is the Eligible Participant’s:
1. spouse; civil union partner, or domestic partner;
2. natural child, stepchild or legally adopted child who has not yet reached age 26;
3. own or spouse’s, civil union partner’s or domestic partner’s own child, of any age, enrolled prior to age 26, who is incapable of self-support due to continuing mental retardation or physical disability and who is chiefly dependent on the Eligible Participant. The Insurer requires written proof from a Physician of such disability and dependency within 31 days of the child’s 26th birthday and annually thereafter;
4. For a person who becomes an Eligible Dependent (as described below) after the date the Eligible Participant’s coverage begins, coverage for the Eligible Dependent will become effective in accordance with the following provisions:

a. Newborn Children: Coverage will be automatic for the first 31 days following the birth of an Insured Participant’s Newborn Child. To continue coverage beyond 31 days, the Newborn child must be enrolled within 31 days of birth.
b. Adopted Children: An Insured Participant’s adopted child is automatically covered for Illness or Injury for 31 days from either date of placement of the child in the home, or the date of the final decree of adoption, whichever is earlier. To continue coverage beyond 31 days, an Insured Participant must enroll the adopted child within 31 days either from the date of placement or the final decree of adoption.
c. Court Ordered Coverage for a Dependent: If a court has ordered an Insured Participant to provide coverage for an Eligible Dependent who is spouse, civil union partner, domestic partner or minor child, coverage will be automatic for the first 31 days following the date which the court order is issued. To continue coverage beyond 31 days, an Insured Participant must enroll the Eligible Dependent within that 31 day period;

5. grandchild, niece or nephew who otherwise qualifies as a dependent child.

The term “primary care” means that the Insured Participant provides food, clothing and shelter on a regular and continuous basis.

A person may not be an Insured Dependent for more than one Insured Participant.

Additional Requirements for an Eligible Participant and Eligible Dependents: An Eligible Participant or an Eligible Dependent must meet the following requirements:
1. Home Country is the U.S.; and
2. under Age 96; and
3. enrolled in a Primary Plan; and
4. For children under age 6, must be enrolled with a parent, aunt, uncle or grandparent; and
5. Initial purchase must be made in Home Country prior to departing on trip.

plans.content:
The GeoBlue Trekker Essential is a multi-trip travel medical plan which offers emergency medical coverage while traveling abroad more than once in a year. This plan covers trips up to 70 days in length per trip taken outside the United States during a period of one year. The Trekker Essential plan does require you to have primary health insurance in place, but there is no exclusion for pre-existing conditions.

With this plan, the medical limit is $500,000 and there is a $200 deductible. There is also a $10,000 benefit for claims resulting from a listed hazardous activity such as, downhill skiing and scuba diving (certification by the Professional Association of Diving Instructors (PADI) or the National Association of Underwater Instructors (NAUI) required or diving under the supervision of a certified instructor).

With the Trekker Essential plan you are provided with an emergency assistance number to call 24/7 in the event you need medical assistance or an emergency evacuation during your trip. The plan also features the Direct Pay program, which will pay medical bills upfront if the appointment was made with a medical provider in the GeoBlue network and GeoBlue is aware of the appointment 24-hours in advance.

The Trekker Essential plan offers 24/7 telemedicine visits at no extra cost to members. Through Global TeleMD, members are able to secure a same day virtual visit with GeoBlue’s global network of doctors. The program offers multiple language options and consultation notes are sent directly to your phone. Additionally, Trekker Essential members have access to GeoBlue’s award-winning app providing medical term and phrase translations, a medicine equivalent tool, and news and safety information based on your location, and more.

The GeoBlue Travel Medical plans are available for purchase only before your departure date. If you have already departed on your trip, do not purchase this plan because you will not have any coverage.

note54da41cb3eb01.content:
Will GeoBlue provide coverage and waive cost-sharing for the COVID-19 test?
The claim will be covered in any of the following circumstances:

 - Prescribed testing from a doctor
 - Contact testing
 - Medical facility admission testing
If there is no indication of the above and the claim is related to non-diagnostic testing as a prerequisite for work, school or entry into country, the claim will not be covered.

Cost-sharing:
Coverage is available with no cost-share for diagnostic testing for COVID-19, consistent with U.S. Centers for Disease Control (CDC) guidelines. Starting January 1, 2021, existing plan rules apply where there may be cost sharing for a COVID-19 test. Please consult your Certificate of Coverage for more information on coverage and benefits.

Are there any restrictions for purchasing plans to travel to a high-risk country?
GeoBlue plans are available for purchase, however we do encourage travelers to review and consider all travel plans according to travel restrictions country-by-country. Treatment for COVID-19 is covered as an Illness under GeoBlue Voyager plans, and we are waiving copay and other member contribution for covered treatment of COVID-19 cases diagnosed. Starting January 1, 2021, existing plan rules apply where there may be cost sharing.

I have a Voyager/Trekker travel plan. Am I covered for medical evacuations related to COVID-19?
Medical evacuations due to COVID-19 are currently not covered under Voyager and Trekker plans.

For all CDC references, please visit: https://wwwnc.cdc.gov/travel/notices

plans.title: Voyager Choice
plans.content:
The GeoBlue Voyager Choice plan is a single-trip medical plan, which offers travelers emergency medical coverage while spending time abroad. This plan does require you to have primary health insurance, but there is no exclusion for pre-existing conditions.

With this plan you have the ability to select the medical limit, and also the deductible amount. This allows you to be comfortable with the amount of coverage you have for emergency medical care while you are traveling. The plan also features the Direct Pay program, which will pay medical bills upfront if the appointment was made with a medical provider in the GeoBlue network and GeoBlue is aware of the appointment 24-hours in advance.

The Voyager Choice plan provides you with an emergency assistance number to call 24 hours a day, seven days a week in the event you need medical assistance or an emergency evacuation during your trip.

Also, you’ll have access to detailed profiles of the doctors and hospitals in the area that you are traveling. This can help prepare you for the unexpected if you need to make decisions about medical treatment when you’re abroad.

The Voyager Choice plan offers 24/7 telemedicine visits at no extra cost to members. Through Global TeleMD, members are able to secure a same day virtual visit with GeoBlue’s global network of doctors. The program offers multiple language options and consultation notes are sent directly to your phone. Additionally, Voyager Choice members have access to GeoBlue’s award-winning app providing medical term and phrase translations, a medicine equivalent tool, and news and safety information based on your location, and more.

When you need to end your trip early, due to a ‘covered reason’, trip interruption benefits can help reimburse you for the cost of air or ground transportation back home. Typically, covered reasons for trip interruptions include a covered illness or injury, a felonious assault, a terrorist event, or an imminent threat to your personal safety during the trip. Baggage protection is also included in this plan. The benefit will reimburse a traveler up to $500 (up to $100 per bag or personal effect) for replacement clothes and personal hygiene items if a piece of luggage is lost, damaged or stolen during transit.

The GeoBlue travel medical plans are available for purchase only before your departure date. If you have already departed on your trip, do not purchase this plan because you will not have any coverage.

Coverage is available with no cost-share for diagnostic testing for COVID-19, consistent with U.S. Centers for Disease Control (CDC) guidelines. Starting January 1, 2021, existing plan rules apply where there may be cost sharing for a COVID-19 test. Please consult your Certificate of Coverage for more information on coverage and benefits.

Are there any restrictions for purchasing plans to travel to a high-risk country?
GeoBlue plans are available for purchase, however we do encourage travelers to review and consider all travel plans according to travel restrictions country-by-country. Treatment for COVID-19 is covered as an Illness under GeoBlue Voyager plans, and we are waiving copay and other member contribution for covered treatment of COVID-19 cases diagnosed. Starting January 1, 2021, existing plan rules apply where there may be cost sharing.

I have a Voyager/Trekker travel plan. Am I covered for medical evacuations related to COVID-19?
Medical evacuations due to COVID-19 are currently not covered under Voyager and Trekker plans.

plans.name: voyager-essential
plans.title: Voyager Essential
plans.content:
The GeoBlue Voyager Essential is a single-trip medical plan, which offers emergency medical coverage while you are traveling abroad.

This plan does not require you to have primary health insurance in place, but there is a 6-month period, prior to the coverage date, for pre-existing conditions. Medical coverage on this plan includes an exclusion for pre-existing conditions, but there is still coverage for emergency medical transportation whether it is due to a known condition or not.

With this plan, you have the ability to select the medical limit, and also the deductible amount. This allows you to have peace of mind knowing you have an amount of coverage that you were able to choose and that you are comfortable with. It also includes the Direct Pay program, which will pay medical bills upfront if the appointment was made with a medical provider in the GeoBlue network and GeoBlue is aware of the appointment 24-hours in advance.

GeoBlue will provide you with an emergency assistance number to call 24 hours a day, seven days a week in the event you need medical assistance or an emergency evacuation during your trip. Also, you will have access to detailed service profiles regarding doctors and hospitals in their area you are traveling. This can help you to prepare and make informed decisions about your medical treatment if there is an emergency during your trip.

The Voyager Essential plan offers 24/7 telemedicine visits at no extra cost to members. Through Global TeleMD, members are able to secure a same day virtual visit with GeoBlue’s global network of doctors. The program offers multiple language options and consultation notes are sent directly to your phone. Additionally, Voyager Essential members have access to GeoBlue’s award-winning app providing medical term and phrase translations, a medicine equivalent tool, and news and safety information based on your location, and more.

When you need to end your trip early, due to a ‘covered reason’, trip interruption benefits can help reimburse you for the cost of air or ground transportation back home. Typically, covered reasons for trip interruptions include a covered illness or injury, a felonious assault, a terrorist event, or an imminent threat to your personal safety during the trip. Baggage protection is also included in this plan. The benefit will reimburse a traveler up to $500 (up to $100 per bag or personal effect) for replacement clothes and personal hygiene items if a piece of luggage is lost, damaged or stolen during transit.

The GeoBlue travel medical plans are available for purchase only before your departure date. If you have already departed on your trip, do not purchase this plan because you will not have any coverage.

Who is eligible for coverage?
Covered Persons are the only people qualified to be covered by this Certificate. The following section describes who qualifies as an Eligible Participant or Eligible Dependent, as well as information on when and who to enroll and when coverage begins and ends.

Who is Eligible to Enroll Under This Certificate?

 Eligible Participant
An Eligible Participant means:
1. A member of the Global Citizens Association (GCA) covered under this Certificate;
2. Has submitted an enrollment form, if applicable, and the premium to the Insurer;
3. Meets the eligibility requirements as stated in this Certificate of Coverage;

Eligible Dependents
An Eligible Dependent means a person who is the Eligible Participant’s:

 1. spouse; civil union partner, or domestic partner;

 2. natural child, stepchild or legally adopted child who has not yet reached age 26;

 3. own or spouse’s, civil union partner’s or domestic partner’s own child, of any age, enrolled prior to age 26, who is incapable of self-support due to continuing mental retardation or physical disability and who is chiefly dependent on the Eligible Participant. The Insurer requires written proof from a Physician of such disability and dependency within 31 days of the child’s 26th birthday and annually thereafter;

 4. For a person who becomes an Eligible Dependent (as described below) after the date the Eligible Participant’s coverage begins, coverage for the Eligible Dependent will become effective in accordance with the following provisions:

a. Newborn Children: Coverage will be automatic for the first 31 days following the birth of an Insured Participant’s Newborn Child. To continue coverage beyond 31 days, the Newborn child must be enrolled within 31 days of birth.
b. Adopted Children: An Insured Participant’s adopted child is automatically covered for Illness or Injury for 31 days from either date of placement of the child in the home, or the date of the final decree of adoption, whichever is earlier. To continue coverage beyond 31 days, an Insured Participant must enroll the adopted child within 31 days either from the date of placement or the final decree of adoption.
c. Court Ordered Coverage for a Dependent: If a court has ordered an Insured Participant to provide coverage for an Eligible Dependent who is spouse, civil union partner, domestic partner or minor child, coverage will be automatic for the first 31 days following the date which the court order is issued. To continue coverage beyond 31 days, an Insured Participant must enroll the Eligible Dependent within that 31 day period;

5. grandchild, niece or nephew who otherwise qualifies as a dependent child.

The term “primary care” means that the Insured Participant provides food, clothing and shelter on a regular and continuous basis.

A person may not be an Insured Dependent for more than one Insured Participant.

Additional Requirements for an Eligible Participant and Eligible Dependents: An Eligible Participant or an Eligible Dependent must meet the following requirements:
1. Home Country is the U.S.; and
2. under Age 96; and
3. For children under age 6, must be enrolled with a parent, aunt, uncle or grandparent; and
4. Initial purchase must be made in Home Country prior to departing on trip.

plans.name: diplomat-america
plans.title: Diplomat America
plans.content:
The Global Underwriters Diplomat America plan is a single-trip travel medical plan, covering non-U.S. residents for trips to the United States. This plan is only available for purchase within six months of your departure date, but can be purchased after you have left your home. The trips must be at least 15 days in length, and cannot exceed 365 days.

The Diplomat America plan from Global Underwriters features a variety of medical coverage limits, based on the age of the traveler. Travelers up to the age 59 can select an Emergency Medical limit of up to $1,000,000. This limit, however, changes for travelers between 60 and 69; their benefit maximum is $250,000. The medical limit for travelers ages 70 to 79 is set to a maximum of $100,000, and travelers 80+ are set at $20,000.

Along with the varied options for the medical limit, the deductible can be set at a range from $0 to $5,000. It’s important to note, however, that there is an Emergency Room Deductible of $250, regardless of the deductible chosen at the time of purchase. The look back period for pre-existing medical conditions is 24 months. This means that if any medical care is needed while you are traveling that relates to any changes in medication, any diagnostic testing, any treatment, or any recommendations for such that had taken place within the last 24 months, there may not be coverage.

As with many travel medical plans, this plan includes the Emergency Medical Evacuation benefit. This benefit has a limit of $500,000. The Emergency Medical Evacuation benefit will help to ensure the traveler reaches a medical facility that is capable and adequate to perform care for an injury or illness. The Diplomat America plan also considers you may not be traveling alone. This coverage also includes the Return of Minor Children Benefit and an Emergency Medical Reunion Benefit. This, if applicable, would provide up to $50,000 to perform these transports.

This plan is available for up to two adults and dependent children or to children traveling alone. The minimum age requirement for this plan is 14 days old.

If you are going to be particularly adventurous on your United States trip, you may consider adding the Low Option Athletic Sports and Hazardous Activities rider to the plan. This will open the Emergency Medical coverage to include a variety of sports and activities that typically would not be listed as a covered reason for coverage. You can find the full list in the certificate information below.

The Diplomat America plan does not only have medical benefits for travelers. It also has select travel benefits as well. For instance, travelers may be pleased to find that the plan also includes trip interruption coverage, dental coverage, and coverage for baggage loss or delay. Not only that, but the plan also includes Political and Natural Disaster Benefit if your trip is affected by political unrest or a natural disaster.

Lastly, the plan includes a unique amount of benefits within the Accidental Death and Dismemberment coverage. It includes Paralysis Benefit, Coma Benefit, Seat Belt and Airbag Benefit, Felonious Assault Benefit, and Home Alteration and Vehicle Modification Benefit. All of these benefits are clarified in the certificate.

highlights.content: Emergency medical evacuation coverage includes benefits for Emergency Medical Reunion
Plan can be purchased for children traveling alone, up to two adults and dependent children
Optional add on rider for Athletic Sports and Hazardous Activities
Includes Political and Natural Disaster Benefit

plans.name: diplomat-international
plans.title: Diplomat International
plans.content:
The Diplomat International plan is a single-trip travel medical plan, covering you for travels outside of your home country, unless you are traveling to the United States. Your primary health insurance may not fully cover you while you are traveling abroad, and this plan can help to fill in potential coverage gaps.

The Diplomat International plan from Global Underwriters features medical limit options to help any traveler be fully covered. The medical coverage options of $50,000, $100,000, $250,000, $500,000 and $1,000,000. The medical limit is set at a maximum of $100,000 for travelers ages 70-79 and $20,000 for travelers age 80 and over. Along with options for the medical limit, the deductible can be set at a range from $0 to $5,000.

As with many travel medical plans, emergency medical evacuation coverage is included. This will help to ensure the traveler reaches a medical facility that is capable and adequate perform care for the injury or illness.

This plan does include coverage for a sudden recurrence of a pre-existing condition – up to $20,000. If the traveler is 65 or older, this coverage is limited to $2,500. The lookback period for pre-existing conditions is a timeframe of 12 months. The Diplomat International plan also provides a political and natural disaster evacuation benefit of $50,000.

This plan is not only for U.S. residents. It can also be purchased by non-U.S. residents that are traveling outside of their home country, but not to the United States. The Global Underwriter plan available at InsureMyTrip.com is built for any kind of traveler – business or leisure.

plans.content:
The Diplomat Long Term plan is a single-trip travel medical plan covering travelers (U.S. and Non U.S. residents and citizens) who are traveling outside of their home country. The plan must be purchased within six months of your departure date, but can be purchased after you have left your home. The trips must be at least 3 months in length, but cannot exceed 12 months.

The Diplomat Long Term plan from Global Underwriters features a variety of medical coverage limits based on the age of the traveler. Medical coverage limits may be restricted for travelers ages 70 and up. Along with the varied medical options, the traveler has options for the deductible as well. Additionally, this plan offers Emergency Medical Evacuation, Return of Minor Children, and Emergency Medical Reunion Benefits.

The Global Underwriters Diplomat Long Term plan has an 18 month look back period for pre-existing medical conditions. This means that there may not be coverage for any loss if it relates to any changes in medication, treatment, diagnostic testing, or any recommendation for such that had taken place within the 18 months prior to the effective date of your plan.

If your overseas trip includes adventurous activities, you may consider adding the Low Option Athletic Sports and Hazardous Activities rider to the plan. This will enhance the Emergency Medical coverage to include coverage for a loss related to a variety of sports and activities that typically would not be listed as a covered reason for coverage. You can find the full list of included activities in the certificate information below.

Sometimes you just don’t know something is wrong until you return home. The Global Underwriters Diplomat Long Term has provided a solution for these travelers by adding the optional Home Country Coverage. If eligible, this could extend your travel medical coverage to when you return home for an additional cost. Check the certificate for all the details.

plans.name: travelgap-excursion
plans.title: TravelGap Excursion
plans.content:
The HTH TravelGap Excursion is a single-trip medical plan, covering trips up to 180 days in length. To be eligible for benefits, you must be enrolled in a primary health insurance plan.

The plan offers coverage for pre-existing conditions as well as flexibility with medical limits and deductibles, allowing you to select both. With medical limits ranging from $50,000 to $1,000,000, you will most likely find a level of coverage that you are comfortable with and best fits your needs.

The plan also includes the Direct Billing program. If you choose a provider within the HTH elite provider network and inform them 24 hours or more prior to the appointment, (or use HTH representatives to make the appointment for you) they may pay for your medical care up front. This can help you avoid a claims process.

Along with medical coverage, this plan offers emergency medical evacuation. This would provide coverage for the cost of medical evacuation in the event your medical care provider deems that you must be transported to the nearest appropriate hospital for treatment of a covered illness or injury. You are also given access to many medical and security services, where you can get information regarding security alerts and doctors at your destination. This will help you stay prepared with travel alerts and health warnings in the area.

This plan does have some travel-related reimbursement coverages, although they don’t match the level of the comprehensive plans available from HTH. These limited benefits allow reimbursement up to $500 to offset the cost of having to change an airline ticket if you trip is interrupted for medical reasons, a terrorist event, or an imminent threat to your personal safety. You can find all the details in the full certificate.

You must not have yet departed on your trip to be eligible for coverage. This coverage is only available prior to your departure of the United States.

plans.content:
The HTH TravelGap Voyager plan resembles the TravelGap Excursion plan. It is a single-trip travel medical insurance plan that covers trips up to 180 days in length. One large difference is this travel medical plan does not require that you are enrolled into a primary health insurance in order to be eligible for coverage.

Also unlike the TravelGap Excursion, the TravelGap Voyager plan includes a pre-existing condition look back period of 180 days. This means that in the event of a claim, the travel insurance company will exclude coverage for anything that is related medical advice, diagnosis, care or treatment within the 180 days prior to the effective date of coverage.

If you are looking for a plan with a little flexibility in the level of medical coverage you have while traveling, you’ll probably be interested in this plan. The TravelGap Voyager plan allows you to select your medical limit prior to purchasing the plan. It also allows you to choose your plan deductible to best fit your out of pocket budget.

The plan also includes the Direct Billing program. If you choose a provider within the HTH elite provider network and inform them 24 hours or more prior to the appointment, (or use HTH representatives to make the appointment for you) they may pay for your medical care up front. This can help you avoid a claims process.

Along with offering coverage for your medical needs while traveling, the TravelGap Voyager plan has limited coverage if your trip is shortened due to covered medical reasons, a terrorist event or an imminent threat to your personal safety. This coverage will help to offset the cost of changing an airline or ground transportation ticket, of the same class, to return home. You will find all the details in the full certificate of the plan.

You must not have yet departed on your trip to be eligible for coverage. This coverage is only available prior to your departure of the United States.

plans.content:
The International Medical Group Patriot America Lite plan is a single-trip medical plan which offers coverage for non-U.S. residents traveling outside of their home country with a U.S. visit. The unexpected can happen when you are traveling, no matter your destination. You can be prepared with extra medical coverage during your trip.

The Patriot America Lite plan provides you with the option of choosing for a range of medical coverage limits. Available options are $50,000, $100,000, $500,000, $1,000,000 for anyone 69-years-old or younger. If you are 70-79, the maximum medical limit is $50,000. If you are 80 or older, the maximum is $10,000. This plan also has a pre-existing condition look-back period of three years.

This plan comes defaulted with a $250 standard deductible. A traveler may opt to select a different deductible amount from a range of options. This allows you to build a plan that works for your coverage needs and your out-of-pocket expenses.

Finding the best care while you're traveling is often a concern. This plan offers evacuation coverage for emergency medical needs as well as political and natural disaster evacuation and repatriation. These benefits will help to cover costs for transportation if deemed necessary due to the circumstances and arranged through the assistance company.

The Patriot America plan also includes limited travel-related benefits for trip interruption and baggage. This will help for a variety of reasons. If your bags are lost or stolen during the trip, you may be eligible for reimbursement. If you need to interrupt your trip due to a covered reason, the plan can help to defray the cost of getting back home.

This plan also has a few optional coverages for travelers. You can choose to add the Adventure Sports Rider for added coverage during your trip. Please refer to the full certificate for further details.

plans.title: Patriot International Lite
plans.content:
The Patriot International Lite plan offers travel medical coverage for individuals that are traveling outside of their home country. It does not include coverage for travel within the United States. Your primary health insurance may not fully cover you while traveling abroad, and this plan can help to fill the coverage gaps.

As all travelers' needs differ, this plan allows you to choose your medical coverage limits and your deductible amount. The medical coverage options range from $50,000 to $1,000,000. The maximum limit for travelers age 70-79 is $50,000. The maximum limit for travelers age 80 or above is $10,000.

The deductible options range from $0 to $2,500. The plan will automatically default to $250 unless you select another option. This flexibility allows you to assess your budget and choose an amount that you are comfortable paying out-of-pocket.

For travelers up to age 64, there is an optional Adventure Sports Rider available to add to the plan. The Adventure Sports Rider will allow for additional medical coverage if medical care is needed due to an injury during an activity such as spelunking, bungee jumping, or wildlife safaris to name a few. Please see the full certificate for more details.

Other coverages include emergency medical evacuation, evacuation due to a political or natural disaster, and accidental death & dismemberment. There may also be coverage for an acute onset of a pre-existing condition. Please see the full certificate for additional details.

This plan also includes 24/7 emergency assistance services that you can call in the event there is an emergency during your trip. These assistance services can help in the event of a medical emergency, evacuation, or if pre-certification is needed.

Optional rider for adventure sports is available to enhance coverage

plans.content:
The Bronze plan is the most economical policy offered by John Hancock Insurance Agency. It includes basic limits of coverage for standard comprehensive benefits like trip cancellation, trip interruption, travel delay, baggage, and emergency medical coverage.

This plan allows you to insure trip costs up to $10,000 per person, making it ideal for insuring smaller, less expensive trips. If you would like to protect your travel investment from unexpected trip cancellation or trip interruption, this plan offers coverage if you have to cancel your trip prior to departure (for a covered reason) or if you have to return home in the middle of your trip, due to a covered reason.

The John Hancock Bronze plan covers typical reasons for cancellation and interruption such as:

  • Unforeseen illness, injury or death
  • Adverse weather or Natural Disaster resulting in the obstruction of public roadways or curtailment of public transportation, that prevents Your ability to arrive at Your Land/Sea Arrangements.
  • Natural Disaster or documented man-made disaster at the point of departure or Your destination that renders Your primary residence or the accommodations at Your destination uninhabitable.

For a full list of covered perils, please see the full details of the quoted plan.

If you are looking for a plan that is more robust in coverage, specifically the medical and evacuation benefits, you may want to look at the Silver and Gold plans offered by John Hancock Insurance Agency.

CONFIDENTIALITY PROTOCOL 

Confidentiality Protocol for Victims of Domestic Violence/Endangered Individuals 

New York Insurance Law § 2612 provides victims of domestic violence with certain protections including prohibiting an individual, insurer or entity supervised by the New York Department of Financial Services, solely because a person is or has been a victim of domestic violence, from: 

1. refusing to issue or renew, deny or cancel any insurance policy or contract;
2. demanding or requiring a greater premium or payment from any person;
3. designating domestic violence as a preexisting condition for which coverage will be denied or reduced; and
4. using as an underwriting criterion the fact that a person is or has been a victim of domestic violence.
 

New York Insurance Law § 2612 also requires that certain insurers establish procedures to protect and limit access to certain personal information related to a victim of domestic violence.

New York Insurance Law § 2612 provides that, if any person covered by an insurance policy delivers to the insurer a valid court order of protection issued by a court of competent jurisdiction in New York State against the policyholder or other person covered by the policy, then the insurer is prohibited for the duration of the order from disclosing to the policyholder or other person the address and telephone number of the insured, or of any person or entity providing the covered services to the insured. If a child is a covered person, then the right may be asserted by the child’s parent or guardian. 

New York Insurance Law § 2612 also requires a health insurer, as defined in that section of the law to include an accident and health insurer, to accommodate a reasonable request made by a person covered by an insurance policy to receive communications of claim-related information by alternative means or at alternative locations if the person clearly states that disclosure of the information could endanger the person. If the covered person is a child, then the right may be asserted by the child’s parent or guardian. The law further provides that, except with the express consent of the person making the request, a health insurer may not disclose to the policyholder: (1) the address, telephone number, or any other personally identifying information of the person who has made the request or child for whose benefit a request was made; (2) the nature of the health care services provided; or (3) the name or address of the provider of covered services.

In the Gold plan, you’ll find the standard benefits to protect your travel investment. Trip cancellation, trip interruption, travel delay, baggage protection, emergency medical and emergency medical evacuation are all coverage offered by this plan.

The Gold plan also offers coverage for missed connection. For instance, if you miss your cruise, due to a covered reason (like a weather-related flight delay), this plan offers a benefit to help with the cost of getting you to the next port of call to meet your cruise.

Like the Bronze and Silver plans, the Gold plan does provide coverage for pre-existing conditions – if you are eligible. In the event that you have to make a claim due to a covered medical reason, the pre-existing condition exclusion may be waived if the plan is purchased within 14 days after making the initial trip deposit (and all other eligibility requirements are met).

This plan also lists several additional benefits available for purchase. If needed, you can add on rental car collision coverage as well as an additional rider that would allow you to cancel for any reason. If you add rental car coverage, be sure to check with your rental car company to see if they will honor the coverage. The additional John Hancock Gold plan Cancel For Any Reason coverage is not available in all states.

plans.name: silver
plans.title: Silver
plans.content:
The John Hancock Silver Plan is designed for both Domestic and International travel coverage. There are valuable benefits you may need before and during your trip when your travel plans could change due to unexpected delays or interruptions. This plan includes a wide range of coverages including trip cancellation, trip interruption and trip delay, plus primary accident or sickness medical coverage. There are no deductibles on claims and you can customize a personal plan by adding optional coverages including Trip Cancellation for Any Reason, rental car coverage and increased Common Carrier Accidental Death and Dismemberment limits.

If you are taking a cruise or a well-planned vacation, the John Hancock Silver travel insurance plan is a good insurance option to include in your travel plans. If your trip is delayed en route to or from your destination for 3 hours or more, the Silver plan includes benefits to help with unexpected out-of-pocket arrangements. Covered reasons include inclement weather, sickness of you or a family member, or airport closures are a few of the many covered occurrences. Baggage delay or loss is covered with some benefits starting after just 12 hours of checked luggage being delayed. Multilingual assistance is available 24/7 in case you need help during your trip or even assistance with arrangements to return home due to an emergency. Please refer to the policy for all the benefits, terms and conditions.

highlights.content: Many coverages included in a convenient package
Pre-existing condition waiver available, if eligible
Primary Emergency Medical with no deductibles
Optional Cancel for any Reason coverage, if eligible

plans.contentReviews:
The Silver plan is the mid-level policy offered by John Hancock and may be ideal for families traveling with children, as kids 17 and under are free as long as one parent is covered under the plan. Coverage is offered if you have to cancel or interrupt your trip for a typical covered reason which can range from an unforeseen illness, injury or death to your destination being made uninhabitable by a natural disaster. The Silver plan does offer higher limits of coverage than the Bronze plan for Baggage, Travel Delay, Medical and Emergency Medical Evacuation.

To learn more, see the John Hancock Insurance Silver product page.

plans.title: MedjetHorizon Annual
plans.content:
The MedjetHorizon Annual Membership is ideal for individuals and families who are taking more than two trips a year (international or domestic) and want to purchase year-round air-medical transport coverage plus additional travel security and crisis response benefits. This membership covers travel up to 90 consecutive days per trip (1, 2, 3 and 5-year options are available). Enroll prior to departure from your primary residence address.

This membership protects you during both domestic and international travel and includes all the hospital to hospital air-medical transport benefits of the MedjetAssist Membership with additional travel security and crisis response benefits powered by FocusPoint International. Members have access to a 24/7 travel security network for advice and in-country response to a wide range of safety concerns including terrorism, kidnap for ransom, political threat, hijacking, natural disaster, disappearance, violent crime, wrongful detention, blackmail and extortion, and pandemic.

Additional benefits included in this membership are emergency medical cash advance up to $60,000, ground ambulance transfer, specialty hospital transfer, and personal travel advisories.

This membership is offered in individual, family and group coverage. A family membership protects the primary member, their domestic spouse or partner and up to five unmarried dependent children under age 19 (or under age 23, if a full-time student). The MedjetHorizon Annual Membership is available for residents of the U.S., Canada or Mexico age 74 and under. For travelers age 75 to 84, please call us at 1-800-487-4722 for the MedjetHorizon Diamond Membership.

Includes  emergency medical cash advance
Must be hospitalized more than 150 miles from home

If you are hospitalized during your trip and would like to be transported back to a hospital of your choice, Medjet will provide the right transportation based on your condition. This membership also includes travel security and crisis response benefits.

To learn more, see the MedjetHorizon Annual product page.

note4ef3a74e2e626.content:
Medjet provides travel assistance services to Members under various membership plans:

1. Individual Membership: Available to residents of the United States, Canada and Mexico under the age of 75. An Individual Membership includes the individually identified Member only.

2. Family Membership: Available to residents of the United States, Canada and Mexico under the age of 75. A Family Membership includes a Primary Member, his or her spouse or domestic partner, and up to five (5) of their unmarried dependent children (including step, foster, and legally adopted children) under the age of 19 (or under the age of 23 if the dependent is a full-time student in actual attendance at an accredited school or college) who are dependent on the Primary Member for support and maintenance. Subject to the five (5) dependent maximum, dependents added during the term of a Family Membership will be covered at no charge upon notification to Medjet prior to initial departure from the Residence Address as defined herein.

To qualify as a dependent child, the child must reside with the Primary Member or be a full-time student in actual attendance at an accredited school or college and be chiefly dependent upon the Primary Member for support.

Diamond Memberships are available to residents of the United States, Canada and Mexico from age 75 up to the Member’s 85th birthday. A Diamond Membership includes the individually identified Member only.

Medjet memberships are nontransferable and are nonrefundable after the membership's effective date. By enrolling as a Member, you accept and agree to the terms and conditions of membership.

A Medjet membership provides access to Medjet authorized affiliates only. All arrangements for medical transport and repatriation will be made by Medjet.

Medjet is a membership program and not an insurance plan; Medjet will not reimburse Members for expenses they incur on their own.

Members will also need to maintain appropriate health insurance in their Home Country that will provide for inpatient admission. 

EXTENDED STAYS OUTSIDE OF RESIDENCE COUNTRY

A Member traveling, living or otherwise staying outside his or her Home Country for an uninterrupted period of 90 consecutive days is not eligible for membership services under an Annual Individual, Annual Family or Diamond Membership. Extended Stay (Expat) Memberships are available. Please contact Medjet for additional information on Expat Memberships.

Medjet provides travel assistance services to Members under various membership plans:

1. Individual Membership: Available to residents of the United States, Canada and Mexico under the age of 75. An Individual Membership includes the individually identified Member only.

2. Family Membership: Available to residents of the United States, Canada and Mexico under the age of 75. A Family Membership includes a Primary Member, his or her spouse or domestic partner, and up to five (5) of their unmarried dependent children (including step, foster, and legally adopted children) under the age of 19 (or under the age of 23 if the dependent is a full-time student in actual attendance at an accredited school or college) who are dependent on the Primary Member for support and maintenance. Subject to the five (5) dependent maximum, dependents added during the term of a Family Membership will be covered at no charge upon notification to Medjet prior to initial departure from the Residence Address as defined herein.

To qualify as a dependent child, the child must reside with the Primary Member or be a full-time student in actual attendance at an accredited school or college and be chiefly dependent upon the Primary Member for support.

If the Member returns to his or her Home Country at any time during that period, the time is reset and will begin again upon his or her next departure out of his or her Home Country.

Medjet’s Expat365 Membership is for the Medjet Member traveling outside his or her Home Country (U.S., Canada or Mexico) for up to 365 consecutive days. If the Member returns to his or her Home Country at any time during that period, the time is reset and will begin again upon his or her next departure out of his or her Home Country. 

Medjet memberships are nontransferable and are nonrefundable after the membership’s effective date. By enrolling as a Member, you accept and agree to the terms and conditions of membership.

A Medjet membership provides access to Medjet authorized affiliates only. All arrangements for medical transport and repatriation will be made by Medjet.

Medjet is a membership program and not an insurance plan; Medjet will not reimburse Members for expenses they incur on their own.

Members will also need to maintain appropriate health insurance in their Home Country that will provide for inpatient admission.

plans.name: universal-cruise
plans.title: Universal Cruise
plans.content:
The Nationwide Universal Cruise plan is only available to people who will be traveling on a cruise during their trip. It is well suited for those who will be traveling up to 30 days with family or friends.

This plan is specifically built for the unique needs you’ll have if you are going on a cruise. Because of this, there are some benefits that are not typically included in comprehensive plans. For instance, Return Home Early coverage allows you to abandon your cruise for any reason, and provides transportation costs up to $250 in order to get home. See quoted plan for eligibility requirements and full coverage details. Some state residencies will not allow this coverage.

More specific coverages include (available in most states):

  • Pre-Paid Excursion Reimbursement – If the cruise line changes your itinerary after your departure and you have secured pre-paid, non-refundable excursions, this plan will provide a one-time reimbursement up to $250.
  • Missed Connection - If inclement weather causes a delay due to a covered reason for between 3 to 6 hours of all regularly scheduled airlines and you miss your cruise departure, this plan will reimburse up to $500 for expenses to help you rejoin your ship (varies by state).

The Universal Cruise plan also includes important coverage such as trip cancellation and trip interruption. If you need to cancel prior to departure or interrupt after departure for a covered reason. The plan also features benefits like travel delay, missed connection, baggage coverage, medical, and emergency medical evacuation coverage to list a few.

Includes the 24/7 emergency assistance services

plans.title: Luxury Cruise
plans.content:
The Nationwide Luxury Cruise plan is available to those who will be traveling on a cruise during their trip. It offers the highest benefit amounts of the three Nationwide Cruise plans. This plan is available for those who may be going on longer, more expensive cruises, as it allows for a maximum trip cost of up to $50,000 per person with a trip length up to 120 days.

The Luxury Cruise plan includes important coverage such as trip cancellation and trip interruption, if you need to cancel prior to departure or interrupt after departure for a covered reason. Other comprehensive travel insurance benefits include baggage protection, travel delay, missed connection, medical, emergency medical evacuation and non-medical evacuation coverage to list a few.

This plan offers optional Cancel for Any Reason coverage for residents of most states that meet all eligibility requirements. This will reimburse up to 75% of your pre-paid, non-refundable trip costs if you have to cancel your trip for something other than a covered reason. With Cancel for Any Reason, cancellation must no later than two days prior to departure. The benefit will allow you to recoup a percentage of the money you originally paid for your cruise.

Unlike the Universal Cruise plan, but similar to the Choice Cruise plan, this plan includes a pre-existing conditions exclusions waiver. This will reimburse for covered medical care needed due to a pre-existing condition, if the plan is purchased within 14 days of initial trip payment and all other requirements are met.

A trip can be planned on a whim or it could be something that has been saved for and dreamed about for a long time. Even with the best planning, a medical issue or a travel delay may arise, and this coverage and assistance services can help you in your time of need.

You can add the optional coverages for rental car collision if you are planning on using a rental car during your trip. If you purchase the plan within 10 days of your initial trip payment; insure the full pre-paid, non-refundable cost of the trip; and meet all the eligibility requirements you could qualify for additional time sensitive benefits, such as financial default coverage and the pre-existing conditions exclusions waiver.

plans.name: prime
plans.title: Prime
plans.content:
The Nationwide Prime plan allows you to insure a higher trip cost than the Essential plan, and also includes higher amounts of coverage for post departure benefits such as medical and emergency medical evacuation.

This comprehensive travel insurance plan includes standard benefits, and some additional options to really tailor your insurance for your trip. The plan allows coverage for trips costing up to $30,000 per person, and provides reimbursement if a cancellation occurs due to a covered reason. Optional Cancel for Any Reason is also available in most states if all eligibility requirements are met.

The trip interruption coverage is available if you need to end your trip early due to a covered reason, and offers reimbursement up to 200% of the trip cost which can help to defray the cost of a one-way ticket home. The plan also includes coverages for baggage protection and travel delay.

This plan also offers coverage for a missed connection. If you face a delay due to a covered reason of three or more hours that causes you to miss your cruise departure, this plans reimburses up to $500 to help you rejoin the cruise and for additional meal or accommodation expenses you incur. Similarly, it also offers coverage for itinerary changes by your cruise line or tour supplier. The benefit reimburses up to $500 in the event a cruise/tour supplier makes a change to your itinerary which prevents you from participating in an activity that you had pre-paid for.

Medical and emergency medical evacuation coverage is available with this plan. This can help if you need to seek medical attention for a covered unexpected illness or injury that occurs during your trip. Also, emergency medical evacuation benefits are available if you are hospitalized and the attending physician recommends that you be transported to the nearest, better equipped hospital.

If you are worried about a pre-existing condition limiting your coverage, the earlier you purchase the plan the better. If the plan is purchased within 21 days of your initial trip payment (and all other eligibility requirements are met), then the pre-existing condition exclusion can be waived.

Optional Cancel for Any Reason coverage, if eligible

plans.title: Travel Basic
plans.content:
Of all the Travelex products offered on InsureMyTrip, the Travel Basic plan provides the most basic comprehensive coverage. It is a good choice for the budget-conscious traveler who needs basic essential coverage for unforeseen events that may arise before and during your trip.

This plan includes standard coverages such as trip cancellation and interruption benefits due to unforeseen covered reasons. It also provides benefits in the event that your baggage is lost or delayed during your trip. This can help to reimburse you for any necessary purchases that are made while waiting for your bags to arrive, or to replace those necessities if the bags are lost.

If your travel plans are delayed due a covered reason, this plan can assist in covering any costs for food and accommodations while waiting for your travel to continue. In order for this coverage to kick in, your travel must be delayed by 5 hours or more.

Benefits are also provided for emergency medical coverage and emergency medical evacuation services if you become ill or injured while traveling.

One thing to note is that coverage on this plan is First Payer Coverage, which means easy claims handling, less time and hassle to receive reimbursement for eligible losses from Travelex first, with no deductible. Funds may be recovered from your medical or other collectible insurance plans.

24 hour travel assistance services

plans.title: Atlas Journey Preferred
plans.content:
Atlas Journey Preferred, underwritten by U.S. Specialty Insurance Company (USSIC) 13403 Northwest Freeway Houston, TX 75379-7408, is a comprehensive travel insurance plan for U.S. residents traveling domestically and abroad.

This customizable plan features a Trip Cancellation benefit that provides full reimbursement for prepaid, nonrefundable trip costs if you cancel your trip for one of many covered reasons. It offers many other travel-related benefits as well, including Trip Interruption, Travel Delay, Missed Connection, and Baggage Damage or Loss.

Atlas Journey Preferred also includes several travel medical benefits to cover unexpected health costs, like Emergency Accident & Sickness Medical Expense, Accidental Death & Dismemberment, and Medical Evacuation & Repatriation of Remains.

Customize your Atlas Journey Preferred plan by adding one or more optional upgrades, including a Trip Cancellation for Any Reason upgrade. This benefit upgrade offers reimbursement for up to 50% or 75% of your nonrefundable trip costs if you cancel your trip at least two days before departure for a reason not already covered by your Trip Cancellation benefit.

Other optional upgrades include a Security/Terrorism upgrade, Vacation Rental Accommodations upgrade, Adventure Sports upgrade, and more.

Finally, the Atlas Journey Preferred plan features travel assistance services to assist you before and after you depart on your trip. These multilingual services include medical assistance and transportation services, emergency travel services, pre-trip information, referrals, and more.

While everyone hopes for a trip free of interruptions or emergencies, Atlas Journey Preferred is designed to be there for you if trouble arises.

You can enhance your Atlas Rental Secure policy by adding one or more optional upgrades, which include Trip Cancellation for Any Reason. This benefit upgrade can reimburse you for 75% of your nonrefundable trip costs if you cancel your trip 48+ hours prior to departure for a reason not otherwise covered by your Trip Cancellation benefit.

Other optional upgrades include an Adventure Sports upgrade and a Pet Care upgrade.

Finally, the Atlas Rental Secure plan provides access to travel assistance services before and during your trip. These multilingual services include medical assistance and emergency transportation services, travel support services, pre-trip information, security assistance services, and concierge assistance services.

While everyone hopes for a trip free of interruptions or emergencies, Atlas Rental Secure is designed to be there for you if trouble arises.

plans.name: atlas-america
plans.title: Atlas America
plans.content:
The WorldTrips Atlas America is a single-trip travel medical plan available to non-U.S. citizens who are traveling outside of their home country and coming to the United States. Your primary health insurance may not fully cover you while you are traveling abroad, and this plan can help to fill in those coverage gaps. You are able to customize your plan by selecting the medical limit and deductible amount that best fit your needs.

Trip interruption benefits can help with the cost of an economy one-way air or ground transportation back home. Covered reasons for trip interruption are destruction to more than 40% of your principal residence by fire or weather (after departure from home country) as well as the death of a parent, spouse, sibling, child or grandchild. Another travel protection coverage in this plan is baggage protection. It provides coverage for replacement of clothes and personal hygiene items if your bag is lost during transit.

Incidental Home Country Coverage is available to non-U.S. citizens or residents to a maximum of 30 days per three-month period of coverage. If you have an incidental trip back to your home country and incur medical expenses during that time, this benefit may be necessary.

This plan also provides coverage for a natural disaster. The natural disaster benefit can help to defray the cost of replacement accommodations in the event you are displaced from planned, paid accommodations due to evacuation from a forecasted disaster or following a disaster strike.

Pre-existing condition lookback period of 2 years

plans.name: itravelinsured-travel-se
plans.title: iTravelInsured Travel SE
plans.content:
iTravelInsured Travel SE is the most budget friendly of the iTravelInsured plans that is offered on InsureMyTrip. Whether you are traveling domestically or internationally, this plan is excellent for protecting a variety of types of trips – like cruises, tour packages, and even family travel.

This plan includes coverage for travel delay if you are delayed for twelve (12) consecutive hours or more during the course of Your Trip for one of the covered reasons listed under Trip Delay in the plan details. This plan also includes rental car coverage if your rental car is damaged while on a trip due to collision, theft, vandalism, natural disaster or any cause beyond your control while in your possession, or your rental car is stolen and not recovered.

If you purchase this plan within 20 days of your initial trip payment and you are not disabled from travel at the time of purchase, you may be eligible for coverage for pre-existing medical conditions. This means that the accident & sickness coverage on this plan would most likely reimburse you for any expenses, even if they were due to a pre-existing medical condition.

This plan also includes missed trip connection for coverage if You miss your trip departure because your arrival at your trip destination is delayed for at least six consecutive hours, due to one of the covered reasons under missed trip connection in the plan details.

highlights.content: A budget-friendly comprehensive plan for world travelers
Coverage for pre-existing conditions available when purchased within 20 days of initial trip payment
Coverage available for missed trip connection
A 24-hour emergency assistance hotline is available for all travelers

plans.name: itravelinsured-lx-with-cfar
plans.title: iTravelInsured Travel LX with CFAR
plans.content:
The iTravelInsured Travel LX with CFAR plan has excellent coverage, like the iTravelInsured Travel SE plan, but with additional included benefits. The plan is specifically designed for luxury and adventure trips to exotic locations.

In addition to traditional trip cancellation and trip interruption coverage, the LX with CFAR plan offers Cancellation for Any Reason and Interruption for Any Reason as an additional benefit for travelers. These benefits are available to those who purchase this plan within 20 days from your initial trip deposit and certain conditions are met. This coverage will help to reimburse you up to 75% of the total trip cost if your trip must be cancelled or interrupted for any reason not listed as a covered peril within the plan details.

The LX with CFAR plan offers a pre-existing condition waiver if your plan is purchased within 20 days of your initial trip deposit (coverage varies by state, please refer to your policy documents for further details). Unlike the SE plan, this plan has up to $1,000,000 in coverage for emergency medical evacuation and automatically includes the hospital of choice benefit as well. The plan also includes $50,000 for Political or Security Evacuation and Natural Disaster Evacuation.

Additionally, this plan includes missed trip connection for coverage if you miss your trip departure because your arrival at your trip destination is delayed for at least three consecutive hours, due to one of the covered reasons under missed trip connection in the plan details.

Coverage for pre-existing conditions available If insurance purchased within 20 days of your initial trip deposit and certain conditions are met
Included benefits such as search and rescue, natural disaster evacuation, and sports equipment rental
A 24-hour emergency assistance hotline is available for all travelers

plans.content:
The International Medical Group Patriot Multi-Trip America plan is a medical plan which offers coverage for non-U.S. citizens traveling outside of their home country multiple times within a period of a year. You must have primary health coverage in effect in your home country to be eligible for this plan. The unexpected can happen when you are traveling, no matter your destination. You can be prepared with extra medical coverage during your trip.

The Patriot Multi-Trip America plan provides you with a medical coverage limit of $1,000,000 over the lifetime of the plan. This means that the total coverage amount for the period of a year is $1,000,000 – not for each individual occurrence of medical care.

This plan does have a pre-existing condition look-back period of three years. A pre-existing condition will not be covered unless it falls under coverage for a sudden recurrence.

The Patriot Multi-Trip America plan also includes limited travel-related benefits for trip interruption and baggage. If your baggage is lost during your trip, this coverage can help to reimburse you for the covered items you lost. If you need to interrupt your trip due to a covered reason, the plan will help to defray the cost to return home.

highlights.content: Medical coverage for multiple trips in a period of a year

plans.title: Academic Explorer Adventurer
plans.content:
The Academic Explorer Adventurer Travel Program provides specialized travel insurance for students and faculty members who are planning to travel for academic experiences. This plan offers coverage specific to travel nuisances that educational travelers can expect. This program provides trip cancellation and interruption protection for prepaid, non-refundable expenses, and is one of the few programs that includes tuition as an insurable trip expense.

If you are a student or faculty member who is traveling for an academic-related trip the Academic Explorer Adventurer travel protection plan may be for you. Whether you are taking a class trip to a national landmark, taking an academic-related trip across the country, or traveling abroad, this plan offers robust coverage that will help protect the travel investment and other post-departure concerns. The plan can cover trips up to 365 days in length and is also available to international students residing in the U.S.

This plan includes trip cancellation, trip interruption, baggage loss, and trip delay. It also comes with optional Cancel for Any Reason coverage in the event your reason for cancellation is not a covered peril under this plan. Also included as an optional benefit is Interruption for Any Reason. This benefit provides you with the option to interrupt your trip 48 or more hours after your scheduled departure date for any reason not otherwise covered under this plan. For a list of all the covered perils, terms, conditions and exclusions, please review the plan fully prior to purchase. This can help you decide if you may need the optional coverage.

plans.title: Advantage
plans.content:
The Travelex Advantage plan is a middle-tier plan that provides comprehensive coverage at a great price. It features strong coverage levels as well as six optional upgrades so you can personalize the plan for your trip. The plan offers standard comprehensive travel insurance benefits such as trip cancellation and interruption, travel delay, missed connections and coverage for emergency medical expenses and evacuation. It also offers coverage for lost, stolen, or damaged baggage.

The Advantage plan also includes six optional upgrades allowing you to customize your plan to your trip. These upgrades include: Accidental death for air travel, Additional baggage, Adventure activities, Pet care upgrade, Rental property security deposit, and Rental car damage. For more details on these benefits, please read the full policy (optional upgrades not available in all states). This plan provides Primary coverage which means easy one-time claims filing so there is less time and hassle to receive reimbursement for eligible losses from Travelex first. Funds may be recovered from your medical or other collectible insurance plans.

plans.name: ultimate
plans.title: Ultimate
plans.content:
The Travelex Ultimate plan is the highest coverage level plan offered in this family of products. It features high coverage levels as well as optional upgrades which can tailor the plan to fit your travel needs.

The plan offers standard comprehensive travel insurance benefits such as trip cancellation and interruption as well as travel delay coverage. It also offers coverage for lost, stolen, or damaged baggage.

This plan also offers emergency medical expense coverage and emergency medical evacuation. If you purchase the plan within 21 days of your initial trip payment, you insure all pre-paid and non-refundable trip costs, and you are medically fit for travel at the time of plan purchase, a pre-existing conditions exclusions waiver can be included.

Additional optional upgrades are available that allow you to tailor the plan to your needs. These upgrades include: Additional medical upgrade, Adventure Activities upgrade, Rental Car Damage coverage, Cancel for Any Reason (Cancel for Any Fortuitous Reason in NY), Accidental Death for Air Travel, Pet Care, Security Deposit, Cancel For Business Reasons, and additional Baggage. Cancel for Any Reason offers reimbursement for up to 75% of your prepaid and nonrefundable trip costs if you cancel your trip at least two days before departure for a reason not already covered by your Trip Cancellation benefit (other purchase restrictions apply). For more details on these benefits, please read the full policy (optional upgrades not available in all states).

One thing to note is that coverage on this plan is Primary, which means easy one-time claims filing so less time and hassle to receive reimbursement for eligible losses from Travelex first. Funds may be recovered from your medical or other collectible insurance plans.
